name: Grouse Grind Trail
quote: Length: 2.5 km one way · Elevation gain: 800 m · Hiking time: 2 hrs +
why: Vancouver's best-known hike: straight up Grouse Mountain. Downhill hiking is not permitted; hikers return by the gondola or the BCMC Route.
note: One way, up: the Grind may not be descended (https://metrovancouver.org/services/regional-parks/grouse-grind). The park is under routes' --min-area, so routes doesn't curate it.

name: BCMC Route
quote: Length: 2.9 km · Elevation gain: 750 m · Hiking time: 2 hrs+
why: The quieter climb up Grouse Mountain beside the Grind, and the way down for Grind hikers.
note: The park page gives no basis; its Grind page gives the BCMC as 2.9 km to descend, so one way.

name: Baden-Powell Trail
quote: Length: 1.1 km · Elevation gain: 150 m · Hiking time: 30 min
why: A 1.1 km section of the 50-km trail, through the park.
note: A section of a 50 km trail, not a hike of its own: perhaps reject.
